# Okal Contribution Instructions

Read and follow `/AGENTS.md`, `/CONTRIBUTING.md`, `/GOVERNANCE.md`, and the
[ShiftCore Team Handbook](https://platform.shiftcore.workers.dev/docs/handbook).

- Never commit or push directly to `main`.
- Work from one task on one `type/short-task-name` branch.
- Use `type(scope): short message` commits.
- Submit every change through a Pull Request into `main`.
- Do not merge without eligible approval, resolved conversations, and passing
  checks.
- Keep changes focused and update tests, contracts, documentation, and security
  notes together.
- Never add secrets, private data, or broad permissions.
- Preserve Okal's thin authoritative kernel and replaceable adapter boundaries.
